title: Through the lens of the Eisenstein ideal
summary: This paper exposits relationships between the geometry of modular curves and the arithmetic of cyclotomic fields through the Eisenstein ideal. For an integer $N \ge 5$ and an odd prime $p$, we define two conjecturally inverse maps between the real part $P$ of the Eisenstein reduction of the homology $P$ of $X_1(N)$ and the real part of the $p$-part $Y$ of the second $K$-group of the $N$th cyclotomic integer ring.
